summary: Paul Kerr contacted HomeNet due to a four-day service outage spanning Monday through Thursday last week. The agent applied a credit for those days and provided a goodwill credit on his next bill as compensation for the inconvenience caused by the disruption.  The call concluded with Paul confirming receipt of the adjustment.

ratings.reason: The agent used the correct greeting and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent correctly addressed Paul by name ("Paul Kerr").

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged the customer’s frustration with the outage, stating “I completely understand.”

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a polite tone throughout the conversation.

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated Paul's issue ("It was Monday to Thursday.")

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated Paul’s account details (account 40028).

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: – The agent asked clarifying questions about the outage duration (“Can I confirm your name and account first?”)

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: The agent clearly stated the credit amount and next steps.

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent applied a goodwill credit to Paul’s bill.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: – The agent took responsibility for resolving the issue.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened attentively to Paul's concerns.

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution

response_times.client_text: I was without service for four days last week and I want compensation.
response_times.agent_text: A four-day outage is a serious disruption, and I completely understand. Let me verify the dates.
Can I confirm your name and account first?
Thank you, Paul. I can see the outage logged from Monday through Thursday, just as you said.

response_times.client_text: So it's confirmed on your side.
response_times.agent_text: It is. I'll apply a credit for those four days.
Yes, I'll add a goodwill credit on top of the four days.
It'll all appear on your next bill, and here's your reference.
I'm sorry again for the disruption. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thank you, Paul, have a good day.
